dispositions.rationale: src/alloc.c is this project's own designated single allocator-indirection point (rcp_malloc/rcp_calloc/rcp_realloc/rcp_free, REQ-ALLOC-001..006) -- the one file whose entire purpose is to be where the real libc allocator is allowed to appear, so every other module can call the hookable rcp_* wrappers instead. Flagging the wrapper for using the allocator it wraps is structurally correct but unfixable without deleting the hook mechanism entirely (a real feature, not an oversight).
